realism.note: Exceptional photorealism across all scenes with remarkably clean hands, faces, and environment rendering.

visual_consistency.note: Character identity, outfit, and grading stay consistent throughout, though the suitcase handle morphs from black to silver in scene 3.

brief_adherence.note: Hits the premium brief perfectly by demonstrating immediate automated delay payouts for frequent travelers.

hook_strength.note: Opening frame establishes a calm traveler walking past congested airport lines, quickly hooking the target demographic.

advertising_quality.note: Clear narrative arc, sharp on-screen notification overlays, and an authoritative branded end card deliver high conversion potential.

issues: In scene 3, the suitcase handle poles morph from black to silver metal.
creative.verdict_summary: This is a polished, high-performing social ad that executes the narrative contrast and product benefit flawlessly. Minor prop drift on the suitcase in the final scene is negligible and does not hinder campaign performance.
